category.title: Cardio
category.intro: Equipment-free interval programmes that build heart and lung fitness. You start with low-impact moves and increase the intensity with jumping jacks, skaters and burpees.
science: The World Health Organization recommends 150–300 minutes of moderate or 75–150 minutes of vigorous aerobic exercise a week for adults; short sessions count too.
Interval training improves fitness; its advantage over steady continuous exercise shows in longer programmes lasting at least a few weeks.
For beginners, no-jump (low-impact) moves raise the pulse enough while protecting the joints.
If you have chest pain, dizziness or unusual shortness of breath, stop immediately and talk to a doctor.

exercises.name: Marching on the Spot
steps: Lift one knee towards hip height and swing the opposite arm forward.
Lower your foot and lift the other knee.
Keep marching briskly and upright.
exercises.tip: Actively swinging your arms raises your pulse more.
exercises.mistake: Don't lean forward; keep your body upright.

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.setup: Stand up with your arms bent at the elbows.
steps: Running on the spot, pull your knees up to hip height.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Swing your arms as if running; keep the rhythm.
exercises.tip: If it's too hard, switch to marching on the spot and speed up again once you've caught your breath.
exercises.mistake: Don't lean back; keep your body tilted slightly forward.

exercises.name: Butt Kicks
exercises.setup: Stand up with your arms bent at the elbows.
steps: Pull one heel towards your bottom.
As you lower that foot, pull the other heel up.
Keep going as if running or walking on the spot.
exercises.tip: If you're just starting out, do it without hopping, as if walking.

exercises.name: Step Jack
exercises.setup: Stand up, feet together, arms by your sides.
steps: Step out to the side with one foot while raising your arms above your head.
Return to the start.
Repeat stepping out to the other side.
exercises.tip: Jumping jacks without the jump; kind to your knees and your neighbours.
exercises.mistake: Don't hunch your shoulders towards your ears.

exercises.name: Jumping Jack
exercises.setup: Stand up, feet together, arms by your sides.
steps: Jump your feet apart and raise your arms above your head.
Jump your feet back together and lower your arms to your sides.
Keep going in rhythm.
exercises.mistake: Don't land hard on your heels.

exercises.name: Skater
exercises.setup: Stand up with your knees slightly bent.
steps: Hop sideways onto your right foot; your left leg crosses behind your right.
Swing your arms as if skating.
Repeat by hopping to the left.
exercises.tip: If jumping is too hard, step to the side instead.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your knee cave in when you land.

exercises.name: Shadow Boxing
exercises.setup: Stand with one foot forward and the other back; knees slightly bent, fists at your chin.
steps: Throw a straight punch with your front hand and pull it straight back.
Punch with your back hand; let your body turn slightly.
Keep going, bouncing lightly on your feet.
exercises.tip: Throw the punch without locking your arm; the real power comes from turning your body.
exercises.mistake: Don't lock your elbow fully; don't let your hands drift away from your chin.

exercises.name: Fast Feet
exercises.setup: Crouch slightly: knees bent, body tilted a little forward, arms in front.
steps: Lift and lower your feet in turn, very fast and small.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep going until the time is up without breaking the position.
exercises.mistake: Don't stand up straight; keep the slight crouch.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
exercises.setup: Get into a push-up position: hands under your shoulders, arms straight, body in a straight line.
steps: Pull your right knee towards your chest.
As you take it back, pull your left knee in.
Keep going in rhythm with your hips steady.
exercises.tip: Get the form right before you speed up; slow is fine.
exercises.mistake: Don't lift your hips up or let your back sag.

exercises.name: Imaginary Jump Rope
exercises.setup: Stand on your toes with your hands beside your hips as if holding a rope.
steps: Do small jumps while drawing small circles with your wrists.
Land softly on your toes.
Keep the rhythm and continue.
exercises.tip: If you have a real rope, you can use that too.
exercises.mistake: Don't jump high; a few centimetres is enough.

exercises.name: Half Burpee
steps: Crouch and put your hands on the floor in front of you.
Jump your feet back into a push-up position, then bring your feet back towards your hands.
Stand up.
exercises.tip: If jumping your feet back is too hard, step them back one at a time.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your lower back sag in the plank position.

exercises.name: Burpee
steps: Crouch, put your hands on the floor and jump your feet back into a push-up position.
Bring your feet back towards your hands.
Jump with your arms up and land softly.
exercises.tip: Good form before speed; when you get tired, drop the jump and do half burpees.
exercises.mistake: Don't land hard; land quietly with your knees slightly bent.

exercises.name: Jump Squat
steps: Lower into a squat.
Jump up explosively, arms up.
Land softly with your knees slightly bent and go straight into the next squat.
exercises.tip: Try to land without noise; the quieter the landing, the more controlled it is.
exercises.mistake: Don't land with locked knees; if your knee hurts, do a normal squat.
